purpose: Prospectively determine whether positive source-wide affinity rank association reflects within-target ligand ordering or primarily between-context composition in a new temporal source.

source_precedence.primary: The first public ChEMBL release after ChEMBL37 whose source snapshot and extraction code can be frozen before outcome parsing.
source_precedence.fallback: A BindingDB incremental snapshot containing only records first released after 2026-08-02, used only if the primary source is declared unavailable before any eligible outcome is inspected.
source_precedence.anti_switching_rule: The selected source and all identifiers are hashed before pKd values are exposed; a source cannot be replaced because of observed model performance.

eligibility.endpoint: Explicit exact Kd with recognized molar units and resolvable ligand and protein identity.
exclusions: Ki, IC50, EC50, Ka, inequalities, ranges without an exact value, and ambiguous units
exact standardized ligand-protein pairs present in development or v1.5-v1.7 external ledgers
records whose primary source cannot be reconstructed under the locked review rules

minimum_evidence_gate.within_target_group_rule: At least five unique ligands and at least three Bemis-Murcko scaffolds per exact protein.

eligibility.failure_rule: If the minimum gate is not met, report insufficient prospective evidence and do not relax thresholds after outcomes are viewed.

two_stage_lock.stage_1_locked_now: Source precedence, eligibility, estimands, dependence units, multiplicity, and decision matrix.
two_stage_lock.stage_2_required_before_outcomes: Commit model code, software versions, training partitions, hyperparameters, random seeds, model binaries, prediction files, and SHA-256 hashes before opening eligible pKd values.

required_model_panel.family: locked nearest-neighbor or matched-molecular-series baseline using development labels only
histogram gradient boosting with ligand and protein features
ligand graph neural network combined with a frozen protein-sequence encoder
joint ligand-protein transformer or another interaction-native neural architecture

required_model_panel.eligibility: Only for a separately frozen structure-available subset; absence does not alter the primary sequence-based cohort.

primary_estimands.name: source_wide_rank
primary_estimands.definition: Spearman correlation over all eligible pairs.

primary_estimands.name: within_document_rank
primary_estimands.definition: Correlation of observed and predicted midrank residuals after connected-document-component means are removed.

primary_estimands.name: within_target_concordance
primary_estimands.definition: Macro average of pairwise ligand-ordering concordance within eligible exact proteins; ties receive one-half credit.

primary_estimands.name: rank_attenuation
primary_estimands.definition: Source-wide rank association minus within-document rank association, recomputed in every bootstrap replicate.

secondary_estimands: MAE difference versus the frozen constant and local-similarity references
calibration slope and prediction-to-outcome dispersion ratio
rank covariance decomposition by document, exact protein, scaffold, and protein cluster

inference.multiplicity: Maximum absolute studentized statistic across locked model families for each primary estimand; Holm correction across the four primary estimands.
inference.source_wide_support_rule: Simultaneous 95 percent confidence interval excludes zero.
inference.within_target_support_rule: Simultaneous 95 percent confidence interval for concordance minus 0.5 excludes zero.
inference.missingness: No outcome imputation; feature failures are reported by family and handled by a locked complete-case plus failure-as-abstention sensitivity.

decision_matrix.aggregate_and_within_target_supported: Evidence supports transported ligand ordering within represented targets; point and uncertainty claims remain separate.
decision_matrix.aggregate_supported_within_target_not_su: Evidence supports a composition-dominated aggregate association; do not claim absence of all within-target signal unless an independently justified equivalence margin is also met.
decision_matrix.within_target_supported_aggregate_not_su: Report source-canceling heterogeneity and inspect prespecified target strata without changing the primary decision.

quality_and_review.prediction_blind_primary_source_review: At least 100 simple-random eligible pairs and all prespecified high-risk pairs are independently signed before unblinding predictions.
quality_and_review.disagreement_resolution: Two reviewers with a third adjudicator; decisions and reasons are frozen before model errors are joined.
quality_and_review.provenance_release: Release public identifiers, reconstruction code, exclusion ledger, and aggregate rights-restricted summaries.

prohibited_actions: changing source, eligibility, model panel, or primary estimands after viewing outcomes
claiming wet-lab, mechanistic, therapeutic, or clinical validation
pooling the new source with retrospective sources for the primary decision
